modelPolicy: Both inherited the root model; no overrides
authorStartProcedure: First recorded start action; then recorded exec cat /reference/prompt.txt reads the entire own immutable brief. Startup commands are included in active author time.

three.initialRoutingInstruction: Only own recorder entrypoint permitted for commands/reads/edits; first start then exec cat /reference/prompt.txt; no collaboration/peer/history/private data; own reference and previews only; finish final build then no edits.

aperture.initialRoutingInstruction: Only own recorder entrypoint permitted for commands/reads/edits; first start then exec cat /reference/prompt.txt; no collaboration/peer/history/private data; own reference and previews only; finish final build then no edits.

runtimeMeasurementPolicy: Fresh browsers, 60 warmup and120 serial fenced measured frames per trial, all raw samples retained, no substitutions for failure. No unrelated producer/build/test jobs during official measurements.
